scope: Existing native Archiver writer, maximum accepted single input, ZIP64 and bounded memory; no transport/domain/provider calls

environment.context: preliminary Linux image with current source overlay

fixture: One 4 GiB all-zero stream generated in 64 KiB chunks. Source SHA256 independently computed with Python and supplied to the existing writer; no source file is materialized.
validation: Python zipfile independently reads ZIP64 metadata and inflates the complete 4 GiB entry to verify its CRC. Zip entry size is exactly one byte beyond the classic 32-bit unsigned maximum.
limits: Compressible fixture measures stream-size correctness and memory, not maximum compressed-output throughput.
Actual Modal Function and live Bundle/R2 acceptance are separate gates.
